checks: The release embeds a separate executable helper.
The helper task has no logon, boot, timed or arbitrary event trigger.
Only the current user's existing interactive session is used, with no stored password.
Only the dedicated task requests the required window permissions.
There is exactly one fixed executable action.
The task invokes the protected helper directly, without PowerShell, a shell or caller-supplied arguments.
Repeated requests cannot spawn concurrent positioning helpers.
A long-running capsule session is not interrupted by a scheduler timeout.
The ordinary user cannot rewrite the privileged task, its owner or its access controls.
Sandbox configuration cannot register a privileged task.
